# Public MAIS fixtures

Downloaded from the public TUKE MAIS portal during T-001 implementation.
These are official source pages, not synthetic or seeded course information.

- `zap.html`: `https://maisportal.tuke.sk/portal/tlacPredmetuOSP.mais?predmetId=65954478`
- `prerequisite.html`: `https://maisportal.tuke.sk/portal/tlacPredmetuOSP.mais?predmetId=2683224`
- `plan.html`: `https://maisportal.tuke.sk/portal/studijneProgramy.mais`, opened by
  submitting FEI (`6878`), year 2026/2027 (`64312664`), `DENNA`, `PRVY`, program
  `65699720` (`ApE_Bc_D_KM`), action `zobraz_studijny_program`.

Tests use only these saved pages and make no network requests.
